description:
JTB is a syntax tree builder to be used with the Java Compiler Compiler (JavaCC)
    parser generator. JTB was originally developped at UCLA up to version 1.3.2
    http://compilers.cs.ucla.edu/jtb/) or (http://compilers.cs.ucla.edu/jtb/jtb-2003/). It has been
    upgraded in version 1.4.0+ (2009-2010), as an embedded tool within the SourceForge Eclipse
    JavaCC plugin. From 2011 to 2016 it was provided as a standalone tool in the same hosting
    environment as JavaCC (java.net). Since 2017 it is provided as a standalone tool in the same new
    hosting environment as JavaCC (GitHub : https://github.com/jtb-javacc/JTB). Version 1.4.12 had
    been deployed to Maven Central (https://central.sonatype.com/artifact/edu.purdue.cs/jtb).
    Versions 1.5.2+ will be deployed to Sonatype Central Portal (https://central.sonatype.com for
    releases, https://central.sonatype.com/repository/maven-snapshots for snapshots).
